title: Ingrateful
summary: INGRA'TEFUL, a. [L. ingratus; in and gratus.] 1. Ungrateful; unthankful; not having feelings of kindness for a favor received.2. Unpleasing to the sense. He gives no ingrateful food.

inlines.v: INGRA'TEFUL, a. [L. ingratus; in and gratus.] 1. Ungrateful; unthankful; not having feelings of kindness for a favor received.2. Unpleasing to the sense. He gives no ingrateful food.
